crop.notes: Only the end of the article (top of the next column) is clipped. The headline 'Mike McCoole. What the Ex-Champion Is Doing. A Tour Around His Headquarters' and the start of the Dublin Tricks interview are in the previous column on the page and are missing.

ocr.notes: Gist readable but many errors, especially in the poem; matches the clipped portion only.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat interviewed Dublin Tricks, Mike McCoole's trainer, before the fight with Tom Allen. Tricks said he had trained Charley Gallagher when Gallagher beat Allen, and denied a rumor that McCoole had avoided Allen.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Sunday, July 13, 1873'; masthead 'Daily Democrat'. Pre-1875 merger.

facts.fact: McCoole's trainer Dublin Tricks said he had trained Charley Gallagher when Gallagher beat Allen in two rounds

notes: Crop should be redone to include the headline and opening of the article in the preceding column; facts were taken only from the clipped part.
